stem: Which statement expresses an idea found in BOTH the article “A Country Connected” and the poem “The World Is at My Fingertips”?

options.label: A
options.text: Hard work is valuable even when there is an easier way.

options.label: B
options.text: Good plans will get used in the end.

options.label: C
options.text: Learning about the past can answer questions about the future.

options.label: D
options.text: Having helpful ways to connect is valuable.
